Second, your LSAT score was notably below the average for accepted students. The LSAT is a critical indicator of your ability to succeed in law school, and a lower score can raise concerns about your readiness for the challenges ahead. 

Lastly, your undergraduate GPA was also below the average of those who were accepted. A GPA of 2.60 compared to the average of 3.23 suggests that you may not have demonstrated the academic performance typically expected for success in law school.
